kind: Configuration
metadata:
  name: p1r-private
spec:

      enabled: false
  nameResolution:

    version: v1

kind: Component
metadata:
  name: statestore
spec:
  type: state.redis
  version: v1
  metadata:
    - name: redisHost
      value: "127.0.0.1:24428"
    - name: actorStateStore
      value: "true"
scopes:
